probe.history: RX context0x1b000,64 records of8 words. TCP sequence/ports read into private plan before original descriptor stores; shared versioned history written after original NI write/doorbell. Guard even encodes(serial+1)*2; odd means update in progress.
probe.impact: Adds prefix reads, private stack storage and shared DDR stores. Code placement and timing change; non-reproduction cannot establish a fix. No data buffer/ring/credit/budget/RF change.
probe.tests: Actual linked514-buffer/reorder/barrier ownership model, six NI descriptor-credit boundary cases and IMEM boot pass. TCP-specific model confirms recorded sequence0x12345678, ports55000/5206 and NI address/length remain exact.

snapshot.trigger: Before-GRO TCP sequence/timestamp discontinuities; bounded16 records. Copies PE history and ordinary ARM VP8 descriptor/packet prefixes. Does not dereference the transient PE uplink-ring CPU mapping.
snapshot.offsets_verified: Installed RTL_xram.dma0x1578, qm0x18d0; radio AP.tx0x36a8. Copied TX/RX layouts match the current source.
snapshot.limit: Observed received sequence numbers appear in the frozen event snapshots, but repeated TCP retransmissions share sequence values and the history lacks TCP timestamp values. This is not a unique packet identity match. Original64-packet stale-block event was not reproduced, so NI publication, Wi-Fi DMA, and CPU-copy visibility are not exonerated.
